baseline.description: Measured the 0.7.0 Execute/Generate migration worktree based on this commit with the pinned Docker toolchain. Includes typed model execution contracts, shared context admission/state/bindings, completed tensor packets and cancellation drain. Initial migration attribution showed unchanged kernel/backend/shader bytes and object counts; growth was in execution control and generated contracts. Initial measurement report SHA-256 c0b16a6efd7ef702b1667c6a28a273f37e6c2f6539d169cbff8c19c685769ccd. The native inference raw-byte and full raw/gzip baselines additionally include measured C/D compact attention, head rotation and resident row features recorded in adjustments. Policy remains baseline + max(0.5%, 8192 bytes); other byte baselines and exact WASM import/export contracts are unchanged. Size qualification does not change numerical or latency tolerances. Six measured E ByteLevel decode-only size cells are recorded below; unchanged exact WASM ABI sets remain required. Measured E/F tokenizer, sampling, source streaming and WebGPU feature growth is recorded in the 2026-10-08 adjustments; policy and exact WASM ABI remain fixed. Measured modern LLM architecture growth is recorded in twelve 2026-10-08 adjustments with matched native toolchains and unchanged policy/ABI; size reduction remains subsequent work. Measured modern portable GPU kernel/generation growth is recorded in ten further 2026-10-08 cells; the policy and exact WASM ABI remain fixed. Measured modern incremental-cache growth is recorded in ten 2026-10-09 cells with original failures retained; growth policy and exact ABI sets remain fixed. Eight measured combined packed INT4/INT8, PTQ, BF16 and inline-source feature cells are recorded in the 2026-10-16 packed-linear adjustments. Seven original task cells are revised to final measurements; one newly failing full browser-pair raw cell is added. Original failures and frozen phase1 adoption, exact ABI contracts and growth margins remain preserved. This size adoption does not qualify actual TinyLlama strict whole-model low-precision numerical parity. The 2026-10-18 adjustment deliberately adopts only the preserved pre-task v11 full-native gzip baseline, retaining the current task's measured growth and original failures. The effective byte limit increases as recorded; other metrics, growth policy and numerical gates remain unchanged.

adjustments.reason: Intentional C-stage compact attention/head rotation/row-domain feature growth. Relative to the successful B artifact, raw bytes increased by 8192: kernel input sections +1193 and runtime-control +2895, with ELF segment alignment. Object count, backend and shader sections stayed unchanged. The old raw limit was exceeded by 1621 bytes. Only this raw baseline changes; gzip, seven other artifacts, browser pairs, policy and WASM ABI remain gated as before.
adjustments.measurementScope: Fresh pinned-toolchain measurement from the preserved first C build; its whole release gate failed an ArgMax token-axis regression. This size measurement does not qualify that build or replace the corrected source's fresh full release verification.

adjustments.reason: Intentional D-stage F32 CUDA compact GQA/head RoPE and resident required-row/device-feedback feature growth. Compared with C official, raw increased 40960 bytes and gzip 17425 bytes. Input section growth 43576 bytes is PTX 20209, runtime-control 19887 and CUDA backend 3480; object count and generated/API/training/kernel groups did not grow. Only the measured FULL raw/gzip baselines change; policy, inference and browser sizes, WASM ABI and numerical tolerances stay fixed.
